note: Triennial election of the county council, 1905: polled 25 May 1905 in five divisions (counted 26 May by T. W. Kilpatrick, returning officer). Markethill is not filed: both Armagh Guardian nomination lists print "Markethill—Wm. Simpson, J.P.", the Hamiltonsbawn member, apparently in error. Returned unopposed.
